verified: Sorcery: the controller of target artifact (not the caster) sacrifices that artifact (eff.edhe65.controllerOf.sacrifices.thenRevealsUntil: sacrificeChoice by controllerOf the target, filter is the target, CR 701.21a, 109.4), then, as the same player, reveals from the top of their own library until an artifact card is revealed (revealUntil who controllerOf the target, CR 701.20a-b, 401.1). That player puts the card they stopped at onto the battlefield and shuffles the other revealed cards into their library, which is the whole library again (eff.edhd23.player.putsHit.bf.thenShufflesRest, CR 701.24a, 110.2a): 'put onto the battlefield' under its owner's control, which is that player. Scryfall rulings (2011-01-01): an illegal target on resolution means nothing happens; if no artifact is in the library all cards are revealed and shuffled and the artifact stays sacrificed.
